name: Akashi Tooru
source:
Hobbies: Messing around with Daichi
Likes: Napping, Momoka
Dislikes: intellectuals
He is a hot-blooded person who acts on his thoughts immediately. Because of this, he is sometimes troubled by his thoughts.
He thinks it would be better if he did not have to fight.
He joined GIZARD to protect Momoka. He is in charge of combat within the organization.

Shuffle ~Bokura wa Omoi o Tokihanatsu~ Proflie

He is a hot-blooded type who immediately puts his thoughts into action.
He is often troubled by the results of his actions. He even loses someone he loves in battle,
He overcomes his anguish and destroys Ganglion.
He has learned that no matter what the situation, there are battles that cannot be avoided.
